subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical design thread for durable final-delivery ownership, and which existing substrate should own the invariant before a replacement PR is attempted?
rationale: Current main has requester-key routing and pending-final delivery state, but not the requested owner-mode contract; selecting the owner substrate and API shape affects public tool/plugin behavior and persisted session state.

options.title: Keep issue as canonical design thread
options.body: Use this issue to settle whether subagent delivery state, session/outbound delivery queues, or task lifecycle owns durable final-delivery obligations before recutting smaller PRs.

options.title: Move invariant to a narrower existing issue
options.body: Close or defer this issue only after a maintainer identifies a more specific open canonical item that owns the same final-delivery obligation end to end.

options.title: Reject a core owner-mode contract
options.body: Decide that prompt/plugin-side discipline or existing routing is sufficient and close the associated ownership work as not planned.

recommendation.title: Keep issue as canonical design thread
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle whether subagent delivery state, session/outbound delivery queues, or task lifecycle owns durable final-delivery obligations before recutting smaller PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the closest current routing change and has repeated adjacent announce-delivery history, making him the best available routing/product decision owner from the evidence.
